description_sq: Apartamente ndodhet ne zonen e Shkolles se Kuqe,pozicionohet ne katin e dyte te nje ndertimi te ri te sapo perfunduar me ashensor.Organizohet nga nje ambient ndenje sebashku me kendin e gatimit,dy dhoma gjumi,nje tualet dhe dy ballkone.Orientimi mjaft i favorshem nga jugu i mundeson ndricim natyral gjate dites.Prona disponon nje post parkimi ne -1 me cmim ekstra.Per me teper informacion na kontaktoni.
description_en: The apartment is located in the Red School area, it is positioned on the second floor of a newly completed building with an elevator. It is organized by a living room together with a kitchenette, two bedrooms, a bathroom and two balconies. The very favorable orientation from the south allows natural light during the day. The property has a parking space at -1 with an extra price. For more information, contact us.
